title: seek research job envelope
description: The JSON that `seek research <provider> --async --json`, `seek research status --json` and `seek research get --json` print for a resumable research job. It wraps the provider's own response with a provider-qualified locator and a normalized status. `get --json` adds the result when the job has completed.

locator.description: Identifies the job. The job ID has meaning only together with its provider.

provider.description: The provider that owns the job.

jobId.description: The provider's opaque job ID: a Google interaction ID, a Parallel run ID or a Perplexity job ID.

status.description: The job's state, normalized across providers. A provider status seek does not map is `unknown`.

oneOf.description: Accepted and not started. Parallel `queued`; Perplexity `CREATED`.
Waiting for action by the provider's user before it can continue. Google `requires_action`; Parallel `action_required`.
Finished with a result. Terminal. Google `completed`; Parallel `completed`; Perplexity `COMPLETED`.
Ended before it completed, without a provider failure. Terminal. Google `incomplete`.
Ended in a provider failure. Terminal. Google `failed`; Parallel `failed`; Perplexity `FAILED`.
A provider status seek does not map. Not terminal.

providerStatus.description: The provider's own status string, unchanged. Perplexity statuses map case-insensitively.

terminal.description: Whether the normalized status is final: true for `completed`, `incomplete`, `failed` and `cancelled`.

failure.description: The provider's failure report, present when the provider reported one: Google's `error`, Parallel's non-empty `error` or `errors`, or Perplexity's `error_message`.

message.description: The provider's failure message, when it gave one.

details.description: The provider's failure object, list or message, unchanged.

providerPayload.description: The provider's complete response to the submission or status request, unchanged.

result.description: The report of a completed job, present only in `seek research get --json` output.

text.description: The report text. A Parallel JSON result is serialized with two-space indentation.

citations.description: Source URLs in the order seek found them, without duplicates for Google and Parallel.

providerResult.description: Parallel's response from its separate result endpoint, unchanged. Present only with `result` for a Parallel job.
